title.romaji: Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2: Episode N

Media.description: In this new series, Satoshi, Pikachu and friends start a new journey towards the "White Ruins." There, they meet the young "N", who can hear the voices from Pokémon's hearts... The door of truth leading to an Utopia for Pokémon and humans now lies open!

node.description: Satoshi, Iris & Dent continue their travels through the Isshu region. After successfully winning his eighth and final Gym Badge against Homika in Tachiwaki City, Shirona invites everyone to stay at her villa in East Isshu, where old friend Hikari is also staying and where they participate in the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup after which Satoshi participates in the Isshu League. Team Rocket, meanwhile, initiate their final plan for the Isshu region-what is their purpose in their desire for the legendary Pokémon Meloetta?

title.romaji: Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2: Decolora Adventure
title.english: Pokémon BW: Adventures in Unova and Beyond

node.description: After their encounter with Team Plasma, Satoshi, Iris and Dent start a new journey in the Decolore Islands.
